title: Clinical Synthetic Data Generation Harness (Realistic, Privacy-Conscious EHR Data)
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (synthetic clinical data / AI test enablement; data-engineering/simulation/governance work, privacy care).

Synthetic-data & digital-twin tools (e.g. Synthea, commercial platforms) and AI/model frameworks integrated at the pattern level; vendor internals cited or deferred, never invented. Regulatory/legal interpretation (HIPAA/HITRUST de-identification, IRB/privacy sign-off, disclosure risk) deferred to privacy/compliance/legal. Never real PHI in a shared harness/twin/AI test env. Automation is Python.
hook: Generate realistic clinical data without touching real PHI
problem: AI and QA teams need realistic clinical data to test against — but real EHR data carries privacy risk they can't take on. This solution builds a clinical synthetic data generation harness: generate clinically plausible, privacy-conscious synthetic records (patients, encounters, conditions, medications, labs, vitals) against a target model (FHIR/OMOP/native), with configurable scenarios and reproducibility — so teams get high-fidelity test data safely.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the synthetic clinical-data model: target standard (FHIR/OMOP/native), generation approach, clinical plausibility, reproducibility, and the privacy-conscious posture.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (Python environment, target data model, isolated environment, privacy stakeholders, reference stats).
Implementation Guide — design the generation harness (entities, relationships, distributions, scenarios), generate a pilot dataset, validate clinical plausibility, and expand coverage.

5 Python tools — assessment/profiling, generation or scenario execution, a fidelity/coverage report, a privacy/validation check, and a scope/config helper — authentic to synthetic-data engineering (safe by default; no real PHI written to shared locations).
Testing/validation gates (schema-valid, plausible, reproducible) plus Best Practices for a maintainable, extensible harness.
short: Build a clinical synthetic data generation harness — realistic, privacy-conscious EHR records against FHIR/OMOP/native, with scenarios and reproducibility — so AI/QA get high-fidelity test data safely. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
